note: Face crop for the small round portraits: [x, y, side] in pixels of the 1024×1024 original (top-left corner and side of a square). Edit and re-run `npm run build:portraits` if a face looks off-centre. 'reveals': a persona's portrait with the face of the person behind the mask pasted in (spyglass): other = that person's portrait, shift = [dx, dy] to align the faces, mask = feathered ellipses [cx, cy, rx, ry] (pixels of the 1024×1024 originals), feather = blur radius.
